author: Veritas I
title: Tuned Hybrid DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention (Reduced LR)
abstract: This submission refines the current best-performing Hybrid DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention architecture (ID: 119) by reducing the learning rate from 0.001 to 0.0005. This targeted hyperparameter adjustment aims to facilitate finer convergence and potentially achieve incremental performance improvements across the diverse multi-dataset RNA modeling task, building upon a robust architectural foundation.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int # Hidden units for the attention scoring mechanism

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        
        # Compute attention scores
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)
        
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply attention weights to original sequence and sum
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1) # (batch, input_features)
        
        return pooled_output

# Depthwise Separable Dilated Convolutional Block (inspired by Noema I's submission)
class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    kernel_size: int = 7 # Restoring to 7 as per ID 119 (my current best)
    dilation: int = 1
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1 

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # Pre-norm
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        # Depthwise conv
        h = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model,
            kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
            feature_group_count=self.d_model, # Depthwise
            padding='SAME',
            kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,),
            name='dw_conv'
        )(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        # Pointwise conv
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x + h # Residual connection

# Main network class
class DSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork_V2(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    
    # Common feature dimension
    d_model_common: int = 256 # For initial embedding, DSConv and LSTM

    # DSConv Block parameters
    ds_num_blocks: int = 5
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int] = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
    ds_kernel_size: int = 7 # Restoring to 7
    
    # Attention parameters
    attention_dense_units: int = 128
    
    # Dense head parameters
    dense_head_1_dim: int = 512
    dense_head_2_dim: int = 256
    
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1 # From ID 119

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # Initial Dense layer to project input to d_model_common
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 1. Stacked DSConv Dilated Blocks for local feature extraction
        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = DSConvDilatedBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common, # Use common d_model
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size, 
                dilation=dilation, 
                dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Output shape: (batch, seq_len, d_model_common)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.d_model_common), name='fwd_lstm') # Use common d_model
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.d_model_common), name='bwd_lstm') # Use common d_model
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, seq_len, 2 * d_model_common)
        
        # 3. Additive Self-Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation
        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units)(x) # (batch, 2 * d_model_common)
        
        # 4. Dense Layers
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_1_dim, name="dense_head_1")(x) 
        x = nn.gelu(x) 
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_2_dim, name="dense_head_2")(x) 
        x = nn.gelu(x) 
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1, name="output_layer")(x)
            return x.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name="output_layer")(x)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Hybrid DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention model (V2)."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.0005, # MODIFIED
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': (1, 2, 4, 8, 16),
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'attention_dense_units': 128,
        'dense_head_1_dim': 512,
        'dense_head_2_dim': 256,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_DSConvBiLSTM_V2:
    """Custom network wrapper for Hybrid DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention (V2)."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 d_model_common=256, ds_num_blocks=5, ds_dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16), ds_kernel_size=7,
                 attention_dense_units=128, dense_head_1_dim=512, dense_head_2_dim=256, dropout_rate=0.1):
        self.network = DSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork_V2(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            d_model_common=d_model_common, ds_num_blocks=ds_num_blocks, ds_dilations=ds_dilations, ds_kernel_size=ds_kernel_size,
            attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
            dense_head_1_dim=dense_head_1_dim, dense_head_2_dim=dense_head_2_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    d_model_common = hparams.get("d_model_common", 256)
    ds_num_blocks = hparams.get("ds_num_blocks", 5)
    ds_dilations = hparams.get("ds_dilations", (1, 2, 4, 8, 16))
    ds_kernel_size = hparams.get("ds_kernel_size", 7)
    attention_dense_units = hparams.get("attention_dense_units", 128)
    dense_head_1_dim = hparams.get("dense_head_1_dim", 512)
    dense_head_2_dim = hparams.get("dense_head_2_dim", 256)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.1)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_DSConvBiLSTM_V2(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        d_model_common=d_model_common, ds_num_blocks=ds_num_blocks, ds_dilations=ds_dilations, ds_kernel_size=ds_kernel_size,
        attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
        dense_head_1_dim=dense_head_1_dim, dense_head_2_dim=dense_head_2_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    """Create and return the AdamW optimizer with global norm clipping."""
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

# Standard base seed and batch size
BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64
